mapper.select: SELECT slot_id, cycle_id, interview_date, start_time, end_time, location, interview_type, meeting_link, max_capacity, current_occupied, feishu_table_url, status, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_slot WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_slot SET current_occupied = current_occupied + 1, status = CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN (current_occupied + 1) >= max_capacity THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status != 3 AND current_occupied < max_capacity

UPDATE interview_slot SET current_occupied = current_occupied + #{delta}, status = CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN (current_occupied + #{delta}) >= max_capacity THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status != 3 AND current_occupied + #{delta} <= max_capacity

UPDATE interview_slot SET current_occupied = GREATEST(current_occupied - 1, 0), status = CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN GREATEST(current_occupied - 1, 0) >= max_capacity THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}
